indications.name: Hypertension, to lower blood pressure in adults who are not adequately controlled on other agents
indications.checkedBy: Overnight agent 2026-11-21: Confirmed by the ORIG-1 approval letter; the original label (ORIG-1) lists it.

evidence.quote: This NDA provides for the use of Baxfendy (baxdrostat) tablets for the treatment of hypertension in combination with other antihypertensive drugs, to lower blood pressure in adults who are not adequately controlled on other agents.

pivotal.indication: Hypertension, to lower blood pressure in adults who are not adequately controlled on other agents

evidence.quote: The efficacy of BAXFENDY was evaluated in a multipart, phase 3, multicenter trial (BaxHTN, NCT06034743) in adults with systolic blood pressure
